Subject: LegacyBank — On-prem / Air-gapped deployment follow-up

Hi Mark —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick recap from our side and a few follow-ups so we can scope the Private (on-prem, air-gapped) deployment correctly:

Summary of needs we heard:
- Air-gapped deployment with no outbound internet egress (updates and model artifacts must be provided via customer-controlled media or secure transfer).
- High-throughput inference for peak trading/claims workflows (latency SLOs ~ <150ms p99 for 1k concurrent sessions).
- Strong audit log and KMS integration (customer-managed keys preferred).

Open questions / items needed from your team:
1) Hardware baseline: do you already have the host GPU servers in scope? If yes, please share the model (make/model/qty) and storage layout. Our minimum recommendation typically: 2x A100 80GB (or 4x A40 / equivalent) with NVMe local cache for tokenizer/KV store.
2) Upgrade policy: how do you want model and software upgrades handled in an air-gapped environment? (e.g., scheduled maintenance windows, offline package delivery, local registry, signed artifacts)
3) Ops constraints: preferred maintenance windows, patching window, and whether a dedicated management VLAN is available for the Redbox control plane (we can run management over an isolated network).
4) Compliance evidence: if you have SOC2/PCI artifacts you can share for environment expectations that helps define our recommended config.

Next steps we propose:
- If you can share your initial hardware spec and a network diagram, we’ll produce a tailored Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and an on-prem requirements doc (attached).
- I’ve looped in Dylan (SE) and Dev (Security) to jump on a short 30-min call next week to align on the upgrade/playbook approach.

Attachments: onprem_requirements.pdf (PDF) — contains baseline HW/software requirements and example offline upgrade flow.

Would Thursday 5/11 10:30am PT work for a short call?

Thanks,

Thanks Mark — great, that hardware baseline lines up with our recommendations. Quick answers on the upgrade/offline workflow and verification options:

Offline upgrade & patch model (high level):
- We produce signed release artifacts (container images + checksum + signature) for each runtime and model version.
- Customer imports artifacts into the local image registry (we provide checksum/signature verification tools and step-by-step instructions).
- Rolling upgrade orchestration runs locally via our operator; by default it performs a canary on a slice of nodes, with automated rollback on health checks.
- For air-gapped customers we support a manual promotion step: the operator will stage the upgrade and wait for an explicit approve command before cutover.

Security / KMS:
- We support customer-managed KMS (HSM / Cloud KMS). For fully air-gapped setups, we can integrate with on-prem HSMs or use a local KMS appliance; we do not require outbound calls.

Verification and audits:
- We’ll provide an upgrade_playbook (attached) that includes verification checklists, rollback steps, and expected telemetry. We can also provide a sample signed attest log for your auditors.

Next actions:
1) Dylan — can you pull the exact k8s + operator version matrix and a short checklist for the air-gap bootstrap?
2) Mark — if you can share a preferred SFTP/Media transfer approach (encrypted USB, customer-managed transfer host), we’ll align on the delivery format.

I’ll include a short MAP in a follow-up once we have the hardware spec + preferred transfer method. Meeting confirmed for Thu 5/11 10:30am PT.

Attachments: upgrade_playbook_stub.docx

Best,
Marissa

Quick tech notes ahead of Thu’s call:
- Air-gap bootstrap: we support bundle-based installs (tarball of operator, CRDs, and images) and a local registry mirror. Minimum k8s supported: 1.26+.
- Recommended monitoring: Prometheus node exporter + our agent for token-level tracing (agent runs in host network; we’ll provide an offline install package).
- Network: management VLAN with outbound access only to your internal registry; inference nodes can remain isolated.
- Please share your full hardware spec sheet and expected delivery/shipping date so we can align the install team schedule.

Looking forward to the call.
